title: Robinson extends R66 12-year inspection interval to 15 years
summary: Robinson has extended the R66 helicopter’s 12-year inspection to 15 years, giving owners and operators three additional years before the major calendar-based inspection requirement.
body_markdown:
Robinson Helicopter Company (RHC), the global leader in civil rotorcraft, has extended the R66 helicopter’s 12-year inspection to 15 years, giving owners and operators three additional years before the major calendar-based inspection requirement.


The change reflects the proven durability and dependability of the R66 platform and Robinson’s continuing review of maintenance and overhaul data. Since its certification in 2010, the R66 fleet has accumulated more than 2.5 million flight hours, establishing an exceptional record of reliability in operations around the world. Robinson internal technical materials report zero in-flight shutdowns to date.


Extending the inspection interval from 12 to 15 years further strengthens one of the R66’s most important advantages: exceptional economics across the life of the aircraft. For many operators, particularly those flying fewer annual hours, an additional three years between major calendar-driven inspections can reduce lifecycle maintenance burden, extend productive aircraft availability, and improve the long-term value proposition of R66 ownership.


“Reliability isn’t something you claim. It is something you prove over time, and the R66 fleet has done exactly that. This change takes what we have learned from more than 15 years of service and gives that value directly back to our customers,” said David Smith, president and CEO of Robinson Helicopter Company. “Since the R66 was certified in 2010, its reliability has been proven every day, in virtually every type of operating environment around the world. It is dependable, versatile and economical, and now it is even more cost-effective to own, operate and maintain.”


From private transportation to utility, public safety and commercial operations, the R66 has built its reputation on a combination of ample power margin, straightforward maintenance, parts availability and class-leading fuel efficiency.


The revised inspection interval is part of Robinson Helicopter Company’s ongoing effort to use field experience, engineering data and continuous product improvement to lower the cost of helicopter ownership while maintaining Robinson’s focus on safety, reliability and maintainability.


For current R66 maintenance requirements and applicability, owners and operators should refer to the latest Robinson technical publications and R66 Maintenance Manual on its website at:[R66 Maintenance Manual Update November 2026.](https://robinsonstrapistorprod.blob.core.windows.net/uploads/assets/r66_mm_full_book_NOV_4795ca5807.pdf)


*This press release was prepared and distributed by Robinson Helicopter Company.*
